redFirst.basis: regression task with tests.expectRedFirst false and no tests.add entry, so no helper proof is owed. The red this fixes depends on load, so a HEAD-against-fix helper run on a quiet tree would not show it. It was reproduced under load instead: 16 concurrent copies of the pgo block x 4 runs with the old mask gave pgo7 red in 18 of 64 runs; the same load with the fix gave 0 of 64, and 24 copies x 6 runs gave 0 of 144.

outcome.technical: tests/test_run_test_gate.py only; run-test-gate.py is unchanged. (1) New _first_line_difference(left, right, width=160): returns None when the two texts have the same lines, otherwise 'line K differs: <left> / <right>' with each side cut to width, plus both line counts when they differ. pgo7's label now ends with 'printed lines, absent / empty: <that, or the same>'. (2) CAUSE, reproduced: the step line is '  %-12s exit %-3d %10s  %s' (run-test-gate.py:5047), so the duration is right-aligned in a 10-wide column. _pgo_masked collapsed each digit run to N but kept the padding, which still encodes the digit count. A step at 111 ms in one fixture and 73 ms in the other masks to '      N ms' against '       N ms'. Raw diff seen locally under load: 'sweep exit 0       111 ms' / 'sweep exit 0        73 ms'. Unloaded, steps here take about 30 ms and never cross 100 ms, so the case passes; on CI, trivial steps sit near 100 ms (pr3 in the failing Windows run 44363694425 printed row=156 for a row of one trivial measured step). pgo7 was red in 44363694425 (windows plain 2), 44366022835 and 44388480667 (linux stress 1). Runs 44385960921 and 44397426313, named in the hand-off, carry only vt8, not pgo7. The CI log prints no text for pgo7, so the CI instance itself is not observed line by line; the mechanism is reproduced, and the next red will name its own line pair. (3) FIX in the mask, not the product: the duration field (the spaces before it, the number and the unit, in every form _fmt.human_duration renders, _fmt.py:187-193: N ms, N.N s, N m NN s) becomes one ' <duration>' token, applied before the digit collapse. The column is intended product behaviour (run-test-gate.py:5039-5045 states why it is right-aligned), so no product change is owed. A check over 13 durations from 0 ms to one hour gave a single masked line. Ruled out by reading: the 'machine:' line reads only the fixture project's own rows and journal (run-test-gate.py:5548-5579, _evidence_io.py merge_seams/shared_the_machine), and each fixture is its own git project, so no concurrent sibling reaches it; the reach-reading clocks are 30 s and 120 s (_affected_tests.py:1305-1306); the root path is not printed on this path. ACCEPTANCE 1: a scratch copy of the suite rewrites one line of the empty-setting text, and pgo7 fails with: line 11 differs: 'GATE GREEN: sweep, browser, tree unchanged' / 'GATE GREEN: sweep, browser, tree CHANGED'. ACCEPTANCE 3: scratch tree copies (nothing written in the tree) whose runner prints differently only when executor.phaseGateOnly is present: (a) an extra line, giving FAIL pgo7 'line 1 differs: ... / [run-test-gate] executor.phaseGateOnly is set and names nothing (12 line(s) against 13)'; (b) the green banner reworded in place, giving FAIL pgo7 'line 11 differs: GATE GREEN: ... / GATE GREEN (setting empty): ...'. The first attempt at (a) and (b) keyed on the parsed names and SURVIVED, because phase_gate_only_setting returns ((), None) for absent and for empty alike (_config_rules.py:319-328), so it fired in both arms. Re-keyed on the config key, both went red. ACCEPTANCE 4: every gate command listed exits 0 (701 cases each for the suite; 1497 cases across the orchestrator's 5-file list); ruff and vermin also pass on the file. DEPENDANTS: _pgo_masked has one caller, pgo7 (grep over tests/ and tools/); no other case shares it, and no other suite imports it or _first_line_difference. run-test-gate.py is unchanged, so its importers and prose mentions (PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md, _evidence_io.py, audit-lookup.py, test_audit_lookup.py) still hold. Importers of tests/test_run_test_gate.py (test_commit_task_work, test_drive_phase, test_drive_without_model) and its path readers (.github/sweep-costs.json, tools/affected.py, tools/verify.sh, COMPATIBILITY.md) still hold: no name they use was renamed or changed, and _derived_base_repo, _excluded_cases, _follower_cases and _full_repo are untouched. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md needs no change: nothing the runner prints or does changed.
outcome.descriptive: pgo7 now names the line pair that differs, and its intermittent red is fixed at the cause: a masked duration kept the column padding that encodes its digit count.
